title: Three cut-off replies in a row end the turn plainly with nothing run or published (Chinese)
pins: Each provider's way of sending a reply cut off at the output limit (chat-completions length, Messages max_tokens, the Responses client's error) arrives while the owl writes a call. After two recoveries the turn ends with the plain output-limit failure: no call ran, no draft reached the reply checker, nothing was published. From the 0.18.0 changelog (cut_off.py).
